page.overview:
What is Flowing Sand River?

After being cast out of Heaven by the Jade Emperor, Sha Wujing was forced to dwell in Flowing Sand River and eat travellers to survive. After Guanyin crossed over the area while inspecting the route the scripture pilgrim would have to travel, she promised Sha Wujing that he would be absolved of his crime if he assisted the pilgrim.
